name: Paidy Gateway for WooCommerce
author: paidyinc

sections.description:
Paidy Gateway for WooCommerce integrates the Paidy “Buy Now Pay Later” service into your WooCommerce store. Because a credit card is not required, younger users who do not have a credit card, or users anxious about security who want to avoid using one, can enjoy shopping with peace of mind.

Features

  • Adds Paidy as a WooCommerce payment method.
  • Supports both classic checkout and the WooCommerce Blocks-based checkout.
  • Supports authorize-only and capture flows (configurable).
  • Capture and refund (full or partial) Paidy payments from a dedicated panel on the order screen.
  • Test mode with separate Test Public/Secret keys.
  • Logging via the standard WooCommerce logger.
  • Compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS / custom order tables).

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.2 or later.
  • PHP 7.4 or later.
  • WooCommerce 8.2 or later.
  • Merchant account with Paidy Inc.

Third-party Service

This plugin relies on the Paidy payment service operated by Paidy Inc.
When a customer chooses Paidy at checkout, payment information is exchanged with Paidy’s API in order to authorize and capture the payment.

  • Service provider: Paidy Inc.
  • Paidy service site: https://paidy.com/

Support

For technical support, contact Welcart Inc. at https://www.welcart.com/
For merchant account questions, contact Paidy Inc. at https://paidy.com/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/paidy-gateway-for-woocommerce directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments and click Manage on Paidy.
  4. Enter your Paidy Public Key and Secret Key (Test or Live).
  5. Check Enable Paidy and save changes.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Paidy account?

Yes. You will need a Paidy merchant account and API keys (Public/Secret) issued by Paidy Inc.

Does it support the new block-based checkout?

Yes. Block-based checkout is supported in addition to the classic shortcode-based checkout.

Is HPOS (custom order tables) supported?

Yes. The plugin declares compatibility with WooCommerce’s High-Performance Order Storage.

What currencies are supported?

Only Japanese Yen (JPY). This plugin is available for Japan-based merchants only.
